name: A Cézanne Catalogue
summary: The coarsely cut woodblock print in black ink is enclosed within vertically oriented rectangle. The print depicts a figure and two dogs. Below them, there is a wheelbarrow. A book is on top of it. Chinese characters occupy lower right half of the print.
